prompt: A slightly high angle, 50mm, in a 1920s radio studio with padded walls. A slick Jewish radio announcer of about 40, smooth clean-shaven face, oiled parted hair, arched eyebrows, dinner jacket, stands three-quarter on, singing with a broad professional smile. A big round carbon microphone in a sprung ring on a stand sits low at his chest, well below his chin, its metal plain. Behind him a tall studio window is smashed, a jagged star of broken glass and a torn blind, with icy white streetlight pouring through. A ruby bulb over the door warms the side of his face, and a soft white lamp lights his mouth. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
